mapper.select: select userdata.username as username, permissionsdata.password as password, permissionsdata.use_permissions as permissions, userdata.created_date as created_date, userdata.updated_date as updated_date from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata" userdata inner join "interviewworks_schema".permissionsdata permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata.username = #{username} order by userdata.updated_date desc

select userdata_details.username as username, permissionsdata.password as password, permissionsdata.use_permissions as permissions, userdata_details.created_date as created_date, userdata_details.updated_date as updated_date, userdata_details.order_item as order_item from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details inner join "interviewworks_schema"."userdata" userdata on userdata_details.username = userdata.username inner join "interviewworks_schema"."permissionsdata" permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata_details.username = #{username} order by userdata_details.updated_date desc

select concat('(', permissionsdata.use_permissions, ')', userdata_details_u.username, '(', userdata_details_u.action_type, ')*|', userdata_details_u.order_item) as fixed from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details_u" userdata_details_u inner join "interviewworks_schema"."userdata" userdata on userdata_details_u.username = userdata.username inner join "interviewworks_schema"."permissionsdata" permissionsdata on userdata_details_u.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata_details_u.username = #{username} order by permissionsdata.updated_date desc

SELECT username FROM (SELECT u.username, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY u.username ) rn FROM "interviewworks_schema".userdata_details_u u JOIN "interviewworks_schema".userdata ud ON u.username = ud.username JOIN "interviewworks_schema".permissionsdata p ON u.username = p.username) t WHERE rn = 1

select concat('(', permissionsdata.use_permissions, ')', userdata.username) as fixed from "interviewworks_schema".userdata userdata inner join "interviewworks_schema"."permissionsdata" permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where permissionsdata.use_permissions in ('GUEST', 'USER') order by case permissionsdata.use_permissions when 'GUEST' then 1 when 'USER' then 2 end , permissionsdata.updated_date desc
